title: 0 and 1 in SQLite records can be directly represented by type codes
summary: Serial types 8 and 9 represent the integer constants 0 and 1, respectively. Both take zero payload bytes.
applies: SQLite 3 master database and WAL files
detail: The value is determined by the type code of the record header. The data for subsequent columns follows the previous value that actually occupies space.
boundary: Sequence type 0 also consumes zero bytes but represents NULL. 8 and 9 are suitable for database schema format 4.
relevance: When checking the offset of each column of a record, avoid reserving bytes for constants that occupy zero space.
